description: Create a chart annotation. confirmed=false (default) returns a preview without writing; confirmed=true creates it.

annotationType.description: point or line marks one moment; range covers xValue to xEndValue.

dateRange.description: Date range and time buckets of the chart view.

end_date.description: End date of the chart view containing the annotation.

granularity.description: Time bucket used by the chart view.

start_date.description: Start date of the chart view containing the annotation.

field.description: Analytics dimension filtered in the chart view.

operator.description: Comparison applied to the chart dimension.

filters.description: Predicates active in the chart view.

metrics.description: Metric keys displayed in the chart view.

tabId.description: Dashboard tab identifier for the chart view.

chartContext.description: Chart view the annotation belongs to. Defaults to a daily view covering xValue to xEndValue.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

isPublic.description: true also shows the annotation on the website's public dashboard; false (default) shows it only to organization members.

tags.description: Labels such as launch, campaign, or incident.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

xEndValue.description: End as YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime with offset. Required for range.

xValue.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO datetime with offset.

yValue.description: Y-axis value to pin the annotation to.

name: create_annotation

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. annotation contains its text, type, time coordinates, tags, color and public visibility; saved results also include ID and update time; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Create annotation
